$comment: SOURCED from 2K's official MyPLAYER Builder page:
- Every MyPLAYER starts with FIVE Takeover slots, preloaded with standard attribute boosts.
- There are 24 Takeover Abilities in total; 19 of them are UNLOCKABLE by meeting attribute
requirements as you upgrade the build. They are organised across the five disciplines.
- 'Hydration Hero' is special: it can go in ANY of the five slots and prevents Adrenaline and
Stamina drain. (Which also confirms Stamina is a gameplay stat, not a builder attribute.)
- Progression is passive as you play. 21 rewards along the way, including 15 Takeover Perks;
one Perk per discipline, of three kinds: Accelerator, Longevity, Overdrive.
KNOWN GAP: only FOUR of the 19 unlockable abilities have known attribute requirements — the ones
the community 'best value attribute thresholds' sheet happens to name. The other 15 are missing
entirely rather than guessed. Until they are added, the optimizer under-values attributes whose
only payoff is a takeover it cannot see.
Takeover Perks are not modelled: they are earned by playing, not chosen at build creation.

verification.notes: 'Each MyPLAYER in 2K27 starts with five default Takeover slots.' Slots are not split by discipline; Hydration Hero can occupy any of them.

verification.source: Best value attribute thresholds sheet: 'Driving Dunk 87 -> Contact Dunks, Silver Posterizer, Air Space Takeover' and 'Vertical 75 -> Air Space Takeover, Pro Contact Dunks, Silver Posterizer'.

takeovers.name: Dish Master
takeovers.description: Boosts passing and teammate shot quality off the pass.

verification.source: Best value attribute thresholds sheet: 'Pass Accuracy 80 -> Dish Master Takeover'.

takeovers.name: Rim Guardian
takeovers.description: Boosts interior defense and shot blocking.

verification.source: Best value attribute thresholds sheet: 'Interior Defense 80 -> Bronze Wall Up + Rim Guardian Takeover' and 'Block 80 -> Needed for Rim Guardian Takeover'.
Best value attribute thresholds sheet: 'Offensive Rebound 82 -> Silver Rebounding Badges + Rebounding Takeover'.

takeovers.name: Hydration Hero
takeovers.description: Prevents Adrenaline and Stamina drain while active. Can be assigned to any of the five slots.

verification.notes: Officially named, with no attribute requirement published. Recorded with an empty requirement list so it shows as always available rather than being silently omitted.
24 total / 19 unlockable is official. Only the abilities listed below have known attribute requirements; the rest are absent from this dataset, not absent from the game.

perks.$comment: 15 Takeover Perks, one equippable per discipline, of three kinds. Earned by playing, so not a build-creation decision and not modelled by the optimizer.
